title: MUNIS deep learning predicts HLA class I T cell epitopes, tested on Epstein-Barr virus
summary: MUNIS was trained on 651,237 unique HLA class I ligands to identify presented peptides and showed improved prediction of peptide presentation and immunodominance hierarchies over existing models. Applied to Epstein-Barr virus proteins it identified established and novel epitopes confirmed by in vitro HLA-I-peptide stability and T cell immunogenicity assays.
ai_technology: MUNIS deep-learning model of HLA class I peptide presentation
